gloss: to move; to change one's residence

definitions.gloss: to move; to change one's residence
definitions.explanation: To relocate from one home to another. A formal word for moving house, commonly used in official and written contexts.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{転居|てんきょ}します。
{仕事|しごと}の{都合|つごう}で{大阪|おおさか}に{転居|てんきょ}した。
examples.english: I moved to Osaka for work reasons.

examples.japanese: {転居|てんきょ}したら、{二週間|にしゅうかん}{以内|いない}に{届|とど}け{出|で}を{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: After moving, please submit the notification within two weeks.

notes:
A formal word for changing one's residence, frequently seen on official forms and in administrative contexts. Less casual than {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転居|てんきょ}{届|とどけ}: change-of-address notification
- {転居|てんきょ}{先|さき}: new address, destination of the move
- {転居|てんきょ}{通知|つうち}: moving notification (sent to contacts)
- {転居|てんきょ}はがき: change-of-address postcard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す: to move (house) — everyday, conversational
- {移転|いてん}する: to relocate — used for offices or businesses rather than personal homes
- {転|てん}じる: to move/transfer — broader, literary

REGISTER:
More formal than {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す. Used on {役所|やくしょ} forms, in official correspondence, and in written announcements. In casual conversation, {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す is preferred.
